text: In India, the Local Government ordered all copies of M.L.C. Gupta's Jat Jati ke Mukammal Halat yani Jat Dar-pan, Part I forfeited to His Majesty; the year of the order is not documented. Gupta applied to have the order set aside. On 20 January 1936, the Allahabad High Court found that he had failed to show the book did not promote enmity and hatred between different classes.
meta_description: Jat Jati ke Mukammal Halat yani Jat Dar-pan, Part I by M.L.C. Gupta: copies forfeited in India; Allahabad High Court ruled against the author on 20 January 1936.
